//: Story Phase 6 crew dialogue, one script per crew member per story state (selectors in data/npcs/phase6_crew.json).
hale.p6_shark_hint: hale[alarmed]: The shark, Captain! Midships, just to port of the mainmast! We'll put it over the side together, on your word!
hale.p6_t9_1: hale[resigned]: Morning report, Captain. Sharks: fewer. Grog: none. Television: holed. Sleeping quarters: occupied by a cloud. Storm: still on the horizon. I've stopped asking what next.
hale.p6_t9_2: hale: I've drawn it on the chart, Captain. The storm. In red. I move it every morning. It's always there.
hale.p6_t8: hale[resigned]: I'll log it as 'storm dispersed'. I'll leave a space under it. Just in case.
hale.p6_t7: hale[annoyed]: Roll 'em, Captain! Every barrel we've got!
hale.p6_t6: hale[alarmed]: Keep your head down, Captain! They're coming over the mast!
hale.p6_t5: hale[coughing]: Garlic. It's GARLIC. Thirty years at sea and I've never smelled a ship do garlic.
hale.p6_t4: hale[alarmed]: Not below, Captain! Anywhere but below!
hale.p6_t3: hale[resigned]: I've written 'the television threw a fork' in the ship's log, Captain. In ink. I'll never be able to show it to anyone.
hale.p6_t1_1: hale[resigned]: Log entry, Captain: 'Sunset. Sharks. Grand Stenchmaster improved his suit.' I've had to start writing smaller.
hale.p6_t1_2: hale: Sixteen barrels of bulk Frog Grog midships. Mags counts them every morning. So does Garrick. For different reasons.
wick.p6_shark_hint: wick[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
wick.p6_t9: wick: I'm sleeping on deck. Everyone is. The bedding smells of garlic up here too, but at least it's FRESH garlic.
wick.p6_t8: wick[sad]: I've no shirts left that aren't yellow, green or bitten.
wick.p6_t7: wick: Every one of those barrels, I'd have scrubbed out. Every one. Go on, Captain. Throw 'em.
wick.p6_t6: wick[alarmed]: A shark went through the washing line! It's wearing Bob's drawers!
wick.p6_t5: wick[coughing]: It's in the WASHING. Already. How is it already in the washing?
wick.p6_t4: wick[alarmed]: Thursday's shirts! THURSDAY'S SHIRTS ARE BELOW!
wick.p6_t1: wick[disgusted]: He gave me the cape to wash. I said I couldn't. He asked why. I said because the paint's the RELEASES, Garrick.
fennimore.p6_shark_hint: fennimore[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
fennimore.p6_t9: fennimore: Squawks is doing well, Captain. Furious, rested, and wearing the sleeping cap in the daytime now. I've stopped arguing.
fennimore.p6_t8: fennimore[concerned]: He asked me if the storm's dead. I told him what you told him. 'For now.' He said 'Smart captain.'
fennimore.p6_t7: fennimore: He's asleep. In the middle of all this. Bald parrots can sleep through anything once they've decided to.
fennimore.p6_t6: fennimore[annoyed]: Nothing gets past me, Captain. Not a fin.
fennimore.p6_t5: fennimore[coughing]: Eyes watering, everyone? Good. Means they still work.
fennimore.p6_t4: fennimore[alarmed]: Keep Squawks with you, Captain! Inside the coat!
fennimore.p6_t1: fennimore[concerned]: A raw onion, Captain, on top of four bowls, in that suit. As a medical man, I'm worried. As a man who has to sleep near him, I'm terrified.
rook.p6_shark_hint: rook[alarmed]: SHARK ON DECK, Captain! Midships, right by the mainmast, port side! Get your hands on it, we're with you!
rook.p6_t9: rook[annoyed]: He's started saying he 'drove off' the storm. Sitting down. He was SITTING DOWN.
rook.p6_t8: rook[happy]: We KILLED a STORM, Captain! Who kills a storm?
rook.p6_t7: rook[laugh]: Throw it! THROW IT! Hah! Look at 'em go!
rook.p6_t6: rook[alarmed]: THE GRAY ONE. They're ALL the gray one!
rook.p6_t5: rook[alarmed]: 'WE'RE PIRATES.' I said it, Captain. I'm not proud. It was the only answer.
rook.p6_t3: rook[annoyed]: 'A defensive feature.' It defended itself against the MAST.
rook.p6_t2: rook[annoyed]: It honked, Captain. At ME. What did I do to it?
rook.p6_t1: rook[annoyed]: 'Seat warming.' He carried a chair up a LADDER to keep it warm. I've carried that chair. It weighs more than Pete.
sully.p6_shark_hint: sully[alarmed]: It's flopping about by the mainmast, Captain! Midships! Grab the tail end and we'll HEAVE!
sully.p6_t9: sully: I'll take a shift tomorrow, Captain. There's fewer of them now. The storm ate a lot of them. Or threw them a long way.
sully.p6_t8: sully: Nothing in the sky. I keep looking up anyway.
sully.p6_t7: sully[happy]: That one hit it right in the middle! Another!
sully.p6_t6: sully[alarmed]: Mind the shadows! Mind the shadows!
sully.p6_t5: sully[alarmed]: The deck LIFTED, Captain. Under my FEET. I felt the planks breathe in.
sully.p6_t3: sully[annoyed]: 'Routine shark chewing.' The sharks don't THINK it's routine. They're very excited about it every time.
sully.p6_t2: sully[annoyed]: It honked at me twice. I'm keeping count.
sully.p6_t1: sully[disgusted]: Is that a FEATHER DUSTER on his hat? That's the feather duster. That's the one I use on the lamps.
brask.p6_shark_hint: brask[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
brask.p6_t9: brask[laugh]: 'WE'RE PIRATES.' Best thing anybody's said on this ship all year.
brask.p6_t8: brask: I'll reload the guns in the morning. Somebody'll ask why they're loaded. I'll say the same thing.
brask.p6_t7: brask[laugh]: Better than a cannon! Barrel to the face!
brask.p6_t6: brask[alarmed]: Can I shoot one? There's hundreds! Nobody would MISS one!
brask.p6_t5: brask[laugh]: Every gun on the starboard side! At NOTHING! Best broadside I've ever been part of!
brask.p6_t4: brask[alarmed]: Where do I POINT this?!
brask.p6_t3: brask[surprised]: I nearly threw it overboard, Captain. Then I saw the card. WAIT BEFORE POKING. I waited. Then a shark came.
brask.p6_t1: brask[laugh]: There's a saucepan lid on his chest, Captain. If he faces the sun right, I can signal ships with him.
gristle.p6_shark_hint: gristle[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
gristle.p6_t9: gristle: Stores count, Captain: fewer sharks, no bulk grog, one ship that still breathes a bit when the wind's in the north. And no garlic. NONE. I checked twice.
gristle.p6_t8: gristle: Sixteen barrels. Gone. I've crossed them off the stores list. It's the happiest I've ever been crossing anything off.
gristle.p6_t7: gristle[annoyed]: Throw the barrels at it! I said it first! Write that down, somebody!
gristle.p6_t6: gristle[alarmed]: Best thing a storm's ever done for me. Then worst. In the same MINUTE.
gristle.p6_t5: gristle[alarmed]: It should NOT be doing that! The WOOD! It should NOT be doing that!
gristle.p6_t3: gristle[annoyed]: 'Exactly the sort of person who'd turn it off.' I'll turn HIM off.
gristle.p6_t1: gristle[annoyed]: Jim's had that jar since the Azores, Captain. As a WARNING. Like a skull on a pole.
jory.p6_shark_hint: jory[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
jory.p6_t9_1: jory: Fewer of them at the rails today, Captain. I'm almost disappointed. Almost.
jory.p6_t8: jory: I've put 'flying shark' on the duty list. As a category. I hope I never need it.
jory.p6_t7: jory[determined]: Every barrel to the port rail! Mind your toes!
jory.p6_t5: jory[alarmed]: Rails! Everyone on the rails! ...No, wait. Stay off the rails. Something's wrong with the WATER.
jory.p6_t3: jory[annoyed]: 'It's not an emergency, it's a SCHEDULE.' I'm putting that man on the schedule.
jory.p6_t1: jory: Quiet watch, Captain. Sharks at the usual. Nobody's eaten anything they shouldn't. Yet.
bob.p6_shark_hint: bob[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
bob.p6_t9: bob[sad]: I've been up two nights. Garrick's been up for neither. That's the whole thing, really, isn't it? That's the whole ship.
bob.p6_t8: bob[happy]: Is it over? It's over. Is it? ...Captain?
bob.p6_t7: bob: Can I throw one, Captain? I've never thrown anything at weather before.
bob.p6_t6: bob[alarmed]: A flying-shark NIGHTMARE! I SAID it! Nobody listened!
bob.p6_t5: bob[coughing]: My legs work again, Captain. Shame about my nose.
bob.p6_t3: bob[sad]: I haven't slept, Captain. I've watched a television die. I don't think you're meant to see that.
bob.p6_t2: bob[alarmed]: I'm not going near it, Captain. I said I enjoy being alive. I meant it.
bob.p6_t1: bob[concerned]: He had four bowls. Then the onions. Then the jar. I worry about that man's insides, Captain. Mostly I worry about my outsides.
ned.p6_shark_hint: ned[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
ned.p6_t9: ned: Still there, Captain. Starboard, on the horizon. It turns. It doesn't come closer. It doesn't go away.
ned.p6_t8: ned[concerned]: Something on the horizon, Captain. Starboard. Turning. Maybe I'm tired.
ned.p6_t6: ned[alarmed]: HUNDREDS of them, Captain! IN THE AIR!
ned.p6_t5: ned[alarmed]: They're going ROUND, Captain. Round and round!
ned.p6_t4: ned[alarmed]: Every fin's turned toward us, Captain! All at once! Like they KNOW!
ned.p6_t2: ned[concerned]: The laugh track carries a long way at night, Captain. I can hear it from the bow. The sharks can hear it from further.
ned.p6_t1: ned: Fins in a ring, Captain. They've stopped chasing. They just wait now.
nell.p6_shark_hint: nell[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
nell.p6_t9: nell: I keep her heading away from it, Captain. It's always there when I look back.
nell.p6_t6: nell[alarmed]: She wants to turn INTO it, Captain! She WANTS to!
nell.p6_t2: nell[annoyed]: Green light all over the binnacle again. I'm steering by Franklin.
nell.p6_t1: nell: She's steering heavy, Captain. Bites in the rudder. I've stopped naming them.
finch.p6_shark_hint: finch[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
finch.p6_t9: finch: From the crow's nest you can see it clear, Captain. It's beautiful, in a horrible way. Like Garrick.
finch.p6_t6: finch[alarmed]: I'm not going up the rigging tonight, Captain. They're using the rigging.
finch.p6_t4: finch[alarmed]: Up's safe! It can't get— ...oh. Clouds go up. Right.
finch.p6_t1: finch: There's a plume on his hat. It's the feather duster. I can tell from up the mast.
pete.p6_shark_hint: pete[alarmed]: There's a SHARK on the DECK, Captain! By the mast! In the MIDDLE! Why is it in the MIDDLE?
pete.p6_t9: pete[tired]: 'Seat warming.' I dream about it now. I dream about the chair. It's always warm.
pete.p6_t8: pete[happy]: The Great Sharkstorm is DEAD! ...What? Why are you looking at me like that, Captain?
pete.p6_t7: pete[annoyed]: Throw the barrels at it! I said it first! Gristle's lying!
pete.p6_t6: pete[alarmed]: Eight hands, one shark! Ready when you are, Captain!
pete.p6_t5: pete[alarmed]: The WOOD is BREATHING! I said it! I'll say it again! THE WOOD!
pete.p6_t3: pete[surprised]: He comforted it, Captain. He patted it. He's never patted ME.
pete.p6_t1: pete[annoyed]: Patch number... I've run out of names. This one's called 'Another One'.
mags.p6_shark_hint: mags[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
mags.p6_t9: mags: Brewing again Tuesday, Captain. Watered. Properly, this time. ...Mostly.
mags.p6_t8: mags[concerned]: My whole reserve. Every barrel. Well. It did more good in that storm than it ever did in a mug.
mags.p6_t7: mags[annoyed]: Straight from the barrel, Captain! They can't stand it neat! I can't stand it neat!
mags.p6_t6: mags: Keep your mouth shut, Captain. Straight up the nose is bad enough.
mags.p6_t5: mags[coughing]: Frog Grog for body. FOR BODY, he said. That's my grog he's tasting in that!
mags.p6_t1: mags[annoyed]: That was Jim's good saucepan lid. COOKWARE. It's STAMPED. 'Ancient dialect.'
jim.p6_shark_hint: jim[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
jim.p6_t9: jim: There's no garlic left on this ship, Captain. Not a clove. I've thrown out the onions. I've hidden the cheese somewhere he will never, ever find it.
jim.p6_t7: jim[annoyed]: Let it have the lot!
jim.p6_t6: jim[alarmed]: My galley's full of fish that came out of the SKY, Captain!
jim.p6_t5: jim[angry]: GARLIC. That's MY garlic, in that cloud. I'd know it anywhere.
jim.p6_t1: jim[angry]: I KEPT that jar as a LESSON, Captain. A lesson! It said DO NOT EAT. It said it in THREE HANDS.
quill.p6_shark_hint: quill[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
quill.p6_t9: quill: The food ban is in the ship's articles now, Captain. I've numbered it. It's article one. Everything else moved down.
quill.p6_t8: quill: Sixteen barrels, Captain. Written off. Under 'acts of Garrick'.
quill.p6_t6: quill[alarmed]: I've opened a new ledger column, Captain. 'Weather (sharks).'
quill.p6_t5: quill[coughing]: I won't write down the tasting profile. I WON'T. ...Garlic, onion, Frog Grog, cheese. Damn it.
penhallow.p6_shark_hint: penhallow[alarmed]: The SHARK, Captain! Midships, by the mainmast! Grab hold and we'll all heave together!
penhallow.p6_t9: penhallow[smug]: A storm made of sharks, named after a man who caused it. In my day, we'd have called that a reputation.
penhallow.p6_t1: penhallow[disgusted]: A saucepan lid. I once saw a duke wear a soup tureen to a masquerade. He was ASHAMED, Captain.
garrick.p6_t1: garrick[proud]: The Grand Medal, Captain. Note the inscription. Ancient. Royal. Mostly illegible.
garrick.p6_t2: garrick[delighted]: Shh, Captain! He's being AUDITED.
garrick.p6_t3: garrick[smug]: Seat warming, Captain. Somebody has to.
garrick.p6_t4: garrick[terrified]: Not NOW, Captain! I'm HOLDING it!
garrick.p6_t5: garrick[proud]: The second cloud has excellent structure, Captain. I'd say it'll drift... no. No, I wouldn't say.
garrick.p6_t6: garrick[annoyed]: The GRAY one, Captain. I'll know it when I see it.
garrick.p6_t7: garrick[terrified]: Not the reserve! Every barrel is a VINTAGE!
garrick.p6_t8: garrick[smug]: You're welcome, by the way. For the storm. Driving it off. Which I did.
garrick.p6_t9_1: garrick[proud]: Good morning, Captain. A quiet night. I drove off a storm, you know.
garrick.p6_t9_2: garrick[worried]: I sit with it, Captain. The S.E.S. In case it wants company. Sometimes I think I hear Franklin.
garrick[worried]: Quarterly estimates, Captain. He was trying to tell us something.
garrick.p6_t9_3: garrick[worried]: No garlic. No onions. No beans, cabbage OR cheese. It's a terrible time to be a Grand Stenchmaster, Captain.
p6.shroud_hint: Over the howl, someone points: the loose shrouds, whipping on the rails. One on the starboard rail by the laundry line, one on the port rail opposite, one up on the quarterdeck's starboard rail by the wheel.
squawks.p6_t9_2: squawks[exhausted]: Bald. Still here. Still angry.
